documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release

analysis.summary: Sportking India Limited reported a strong financial and operational performance for Q2 and H1 FY27, driven by healthy demand across key export and domestic markets, improved realizations, and a stable raw material environment. Management highlighted that their 150,000 spindle greenfield expansion project in Odisha is progressing on schedule for commercial production to start within 30 to 40 days, which will provide headroom for future growth. Furthermore, the company remains optimistic about medium- to long-term industry tailwinds, including supportive global trade developments and sustainability initiatives like solar power integration. Sportking India Limited reported its Q2 and H1 FY27 financial and operational performance, highlighting strong revenue growth, improved profitability, and high capacity utilization exceeding 96%. The company announced a major greenfield expansion in Odisha adding 1.50 lakh spindles and strategic acquisitions for forward integration into fabrics and garments.

guidance.claim: The company expects a contribution of INR150 crores to INR200 crores from the new capacity for the remaining period of the financial year.
guidance.quote: So we expect a contribution of around INR150 crores to INR200 crores coming off the capacity in the time left in this financial year.

guidance.claim: Management anticipates revenue of INR1,200 crores to INR1,300 crores from the new Odisha project next financial year.
guidance.quote: And we expect a revenue of around INR1,200 to INR1,300 crores in next financial year and about INR150 to INR200 crores in this financial year.

guidance.claim: Margins in the Odisha unit are projected to be at least 4% to 5%, or possibly 6% higher than baseline operations once operational.
guidance.quote: So, our margins in Odisha unit will be at least 4% to 5%, or maybe 6% more than whatever we achieve once it is operational.

guidance.claim: The company expects revenue to reach around INR3,000 crores for the current financial year compared to INR2,500 crores last year.
guidance.quote: So this year, last year, our top line was around INR2,500 crores. So this year, we are expecting somewhere around INR3,000 crores.

guidance.claim: Management targets revenue to go up to more than INR4,000 crores next year with the new plant.
guidance.quote: And next year, with the new plant, we see this going up to around more than INR4,000 crores.

guidance.claim: The company gives a long-term EBITDA margin guidance of 15% once the new project comes in.
guidance.quote: So we give a long-term guidance of once a new project comes in a guidance of 15%, and we'll stick to that.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand from export markets remained healthy, driven by improving business conditions across the global textile value chain.
demand_outlook.quote: Demand from our export markets continued to be healthy, supported by improving business conditions across the global textile value chain.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand from China and Bangladesh continues to be robust.
demand_outlook.quote: So the demand from China and Bangladesh continue to be robust and the Indian market was a little bit slow in last 2 months, 3 months, but with this festival season approaching and the spring production commencing after Diwali, which is traditionally the peak season for the domestic market.

demand_outlook.claim: The company currently holds demand visibility for yarn up to 10 March.
demand_outlook.quote: So right now we have a visibility for the next till 10 March and it is pretty good.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand from all markets continued to remain healthy, and the outlook going into the second quarter is encouraging.
demand_outlook.quote: Demand from all the markets continued to remain healthy, and we are also encouraged by the outlook going into the second quarter.

demand_outlook.claim: On the domestic front, demand is expected to remain supportive in coming quarters, aided by the festive season and improving consumption trends.
demand_outlook.quote: On the domestic front, we expect demand to remain supportive in the coming quarters, aided by the festive season and improving consumption trends.

demand_outlook.claim: Incremental demand coming into India for yarn export is mostly from China due to subdued Chinese markets previously and smaller cotton crops.
demand_outlook.quote: So most of the incremental demand, which has come into India for yarn export is from China.

demand_outlook.claim: The company maintains an order book ranging from 70 to 90 days in any year.
demand_outlook.quote: We have an order book ranging from 70 to 90 days in any year, whether it is this year or even the last year or whichever year because this is our policy we work to manage our risk of having higher inventory.

capex_expansion.claim: The 150,000 spindle greenfield expansion project in Odisha is progressing on schedule with building construction almost complete.
capex_expansion.quote: On the strategic front are 150,000 spindle Greenfield expansion project in Odisha continues to progress on schedule. Having secured all necessary regulatory approvals, the building construction is now almost complete.

capex_expansion.claim: The entire machinery package has been ordered, has started arriving on site, and erection of initial machinery is underway.
capex_expansion.quote: The entire machinery package has been ordered and has started arriving on the site in a staggered manner. Erection of the initial machinery shipments is currently underway and we expect commissioning in the coming months.

capex_expansion.claim: The proposed capex programme is planned to take 12-15 months to complete.
capex_expansion.quote: # Proposed capex programme to tak 12-15 months to complete

capex_expansion.claim: The Board approved the acquisition of a majority stake in Marvel Dyers and Processors Private Limited and manufacturing facilities of Sobhagia Sales Private Limited.
capex_expansion.quote: The Board has approved the acquisition of a majority stake in Marvel Dyers and Processors Private Limited, along with the acquisition of manufacturing facilities of Sobhagia Sales Private Limited on a slump sale basis and land and building on lease basis, subject to the completion and execution of definitive agreements.

capex_expansion.claim: The 150,000-spindle greenfield expansion project in Odisha is progressing as planned, with construction underway.
capex_expansion.quote: Our 150,000-spindle greenfield expansion project in Odisha is also progressing as planned. We are very excited with that. Construction activities is underway and the first phase of production is expected to commence during the third quarter of the current financial year and we intend to finish our whole project within this financial year.

capex_expansion.claim: The total capex announced for the Odisha project is about INR1,000 crores, specifically INR975 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: So ma'am, right now, what we have announced is about INR1000 crores, INR975 crores and which will be completed by the end of this financial year.

margins_costs.claim: The successful commissioning of the solar power project is expected to reduce annual power costs by approximately 15%.
margins_costs.quote: Beyond supporting our environmental goals, the project is expected to reduce annual power costs by approximately 15%. Thereby enhancing our overall cost competitiveness.

margins_costs.claim: Management expects depreciation run rate to be around INR17 crores from the next quarter.
margins_costs.quote: So from next quarter, we expect the run rate to be around INR17 crores – vis-à-vis INR24 in last quarter and INR14 in this quarter.

margins_costs.claim: The solar power plant is expected to save power cost by about 12-15% in the long term.
margins_costs.quote: Commenced commercial operations of power supply on 18th June 2026 and is expected to save power cost by about 12-15% in the long term.

margins_costs.claim: The overall spread during the quarter was INR133 per kg compared to INR107 in the previous quarter.
margins_costs.quote: So the overall spread was INR133 vis-a-vis INR107 last quarter.

margins_costs.claim: The solar power project is expected to reduce annual power costs by approximately 12% to 15%.
margins_costs.quote: The project is expected to reduce our annual power cost by approximately 12% to 15%, while simultaneously increasing the share of renewable energy in our overall power consumption.

margins_costs.claim: The annual cost saving from the solar project is quantified around INR15 crores.
margins_costs.quote: It should be around INR15 crores with this solar park, yes.

margins_costs.claim: Margins coming out of the Odisha plant are expected to be at least 300 to 400 basis points higher than older plants due to embedded incentives.
margins_costs.quote: So about EBITDA accretion, this plant has many incentives which are embedded. So we expect the margins coming out of that plant to be at least 300 to 400 basis points or even more than what we do in our old plants.

orders_capacity.claim: Existing manufacturing facilities operated at 99% capacity during the quarter.
orders_capacity.quote: This expansion is strategically positioned to support our long-term growth and meet rising customer demands, as the company is already cranking up at 99% capacity this quarter.

orders_capacity.claim: The company's country-wide production run rate is about 115,000 tons.
orders_capacity.quote: So out of a basket of 115,000 tons run rate what we are doing right now as a country, I think around 75,000 comes from these 2 countries.

capital_allocation.claim: The SPV commissioned a solar power plant with a capacity of 40.3 MW for supply of power to the Bathinda and Ludhiana units.
capital_allocation.quote: The SPV has commissioned the Solar Power Plant with capacity of 40.3 MW for supply of power to Company`s Bathinda and Ludhiana Unit for period of 25 years.

risks_headwinds.claim: Trade receivables increased from INR396.2 crores in March 2026 to INR473.5 crores in September due to higher overall billing and sales.
risks_headwinds.quote: So this is I think maybe -- I think if you see the number of days, there won't be much difference. I think it's just because our total turnover has gone up and most of our kind of sales are at 120 days credit covered by LC, 120 days LC.

risks_headwinds.claim: Global cotton prices have shown some turbulence in recent months.
risks_headwinds.quote: While global cotton prices have shown some turbulence in recent months, we remain focused on prudent procurement and efficient inventory management.

management_commitments.claim: The company intends to start commercial production at the Odisha greenfield project within the next 30 to 40 days.
management_commitments.quote: Like, our Greenfield project to come in 8 months is a big achievement for us and we intend to start commercial production within next 30 days, 40 days.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to merge compliant fabric and garment companies within the next couple of months.
management_commitments.quote: So I think within next couple of months we intend to -- I think this will happen.

management_commitments.claim: The first phase of production for the Odisha greenfield expansion is expected to commence during the third quarter of the current financial year, and the whole project is intended to be finished within this financial year.
management_commitments.quote: Construction activities is underway and the first phase of production is expected to commence during the third quarter of the current financial year and we intend to finish our whole project within this financial year.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to reach about 90% capacity utilization for the whole Odisha plant by March end.
management_commitments.quote: And I think by March end, we should be at about 90% capacity utilization for the whole plant.

management_commitments.claim: The full impact of the acquisition of downstream businesses is expected to start coming from next financial year, contributing around INR250 crores.
management_commitments.quote: and we expect the full impact start coming, which will be around INR250 crores from next financial year.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
